description: Drillholes with their downhole geometry (desurveyed from dip/azimuth) for an area, Company holes carry per-interval Au grade + trajectory; open-file holes are collar + total depth only. Give a bbox (west/south/east/north) OR a point (lon/lat, with radius_km). Returns holes[] each with collar lon/lat, src (company|openfile) and intervals[{f,t,dip,az,au}], capped for size, and view3dUrl: the platform's interactive 3D view of the same area (grades by element, rock log, sections; opens in a browser, no sign-in). Give the user view3dUrl to look at the holes in 3D.

radius_km.description: Point mode: half-size of the square, km (0.5-8).

name: get_drillhole_traces
title: Get drillhole traces
